# Check the Docker container's security posture
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{.Config.Image}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Privileged ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{.HostConfig.Privileged}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== CapAdd ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{.HostConfig.CapAdd}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== NetworkMode ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Mounts ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{json .Mounts}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== User ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{.Config.User}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== PortBindings ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== RestartPolicy ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' 2>/dev/null

# Check if the game serves any sensitive endpoints or has server-side logic
curl -s http://localhost:8081/ | grep -iE 'fetch|api|websocket|eval|innerHTML|document\.write|postMessage|localStorage|cookie' | head -10
echo "=== Check for exposed files ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8081/../etc/passwd 2>/dev/null
echo ""
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8081/..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd 2>/dev/null
echo ""
# Check if there's any server-side code (not just static files)
curl -sI http://localhost:8081/ | grep -iE 'server|x-powered|server-timing'

# Check firewall/iptables for port 8081 exposure
iptables -L INPUT -n 2>/dev/null | grep 8081 || echo "No specific iptables rule for 8081"
echo "=== UFW ==="
ufw status 2>/dev/null | grep 8081 || echo "UFW not active or no rule for 8081"
echo "=== What's listening on 8081 ==="
ss -tlnp | grep 8081

# Check the Dockerfile to understand what's inside the image
docker history mario-game-v2 --no-trunc 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== Image layers ==="
docker inspect mario-game-v2 --format '{{json .RootFS.Layers}}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "=== Check if nginx config has any sensitive settings ==="
docker exec mario-game-v2 cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf 2>/dev/null | head -30 || echo "Not nginx"
docker exec mario-game-v2 cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf 2>/dev/null | head -30 || echo "No default.conf"

# Check what process is running inside the container
docker exec mario-game-v2 ps aux 2>/dev/null || docker top mario-game-v2 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Check if it's a static file server ==="
docker exec mario-game-v2 ls /usr/share/nginx/html/ 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo "Not nginx html dir"
docker exec mario-game-v2 ls /app/ 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo "No /app dir"
docker exec mario-game-v2 ls /usr/src/app/ 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo "No /usr/src/app dir"
echo "=== Check base image ==="
docker exec mario-game-v2 cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5

# Final check: is the server writable? Can someone upload files?
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8081/test.txt -d "malicious" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}"
echo ""
curl -s -X PUT http://localhost:8081/test.txt -d "malicious" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}"
echo ""
# Check if http-server has any known CVEs with directory listing
curl -s http://localhost:8081/ | grep -c "Index of\|Directory listing\|listing directory"

## Mario游戏容器安全审计（2026-05-29）

### 容器配置
- 镜像：super-mario-game（Alpine Linux 3.21）
- 进程：http-server（静态文件服务器，仅serve /dist目录）
- 端口：8081→8080，绑定 0.0.0.0（公网可达）
- Privileged：false，无额外capabilities
- NetworkMode：bridge（默认隔离）
- Mounts：无（无宿主机目录挂载）
- User：root（容器内，但无挂载无特权，风险低）

### 安全评估
- ✅ 纯静态文件服务，无服务端逻辑、无API、无WebSocket
- ✅ 无目录遍历漏洞（../etc/passwd 返回404）
- ✅ 无写入权限（POST/PUT 返回405）
- ✅ 无目录列表暴露
- ✅ 无敏感header泄露
- ✅ 容器无特权、无挂载、bridge网络隔离
- ⚠️ 端口8081绑定0.0.0.0，公网可达，无防火墙规则限制
- ⚠️ 无restart policy，崩溃后不会自动重启

### 风险等级：极低
纯静态HTML5游戏，Alpine+http-server，无攻击面。唯一建议：不玩时 `docker stop mario-game-v2` 关闭端口。
